Class Spaceship

java.lang.Object
com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity.Spaceship
Direct Known Subclasses:
EnemySpaceship, PlayerSpaceship
public abstract class Spaceship extends Object
Abstract base for anything that flies around on screen as a "ship" — shared position, size, image, and bounding box. Movement and shooting behavior are left entirely to subclasses (PlayerSpaceship reads WASD input, EnemySpaceship variants run their own AI) — that's the polymorphism seam: update() and render() mean something different for every concrete ship type, but GameController can treat any Spaceship uniformly wherever it doesn't need to care which kind it is.

    • render

      public void render(Graphics2D graphics)
      Default rendering draws the sprite as-is. Subclasses can override this for custom visuals — e.g. PlayerSpaceship overrides it to blink while invulnerable, and enemy ships without a sprite asset draw a shape instead.
      Parameters:
      graphics - destination graphics context
